articleTitle: Medium-term Prediction of PV Power based on PConv-Informer Modeling Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: With the development of renewable energy, the installed capacity of photovoltaic power is increasing rapidly. Aiming at the long-term planning of photovoltaic grid-connected, photovoltaic power (PV) maintenance planning, and power plant economic planning, this paper proposes a medium-term forecasting method of photovoltaic power generation based on PConv-Informer. Inspired by PConv in FasterNet, this method migrates the problem of reducing parameter redundancy applied in image processing to the problem of processing time series with sparse features. The data features are fully extracted by PConv, and the medium-term prediction of PV power generation is realized by Informer. Compared with other models in different data sets, the robustness and prediction accuracy of the proposed method are proved.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Simulation of A Self-Excited Oscillation Fluxgate Current Sensor Based On ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Self-excited oscillation fluxgate current sensors are widely used for detecting DC leakage currents in photovoltaic (PV) inverters due to their high precision, stability and compact size. Since the performance of the fluxgate transducer is comprehensively influenced by the careful selection of the core and the circuit design, it is necessary to simulate the performance of the fluxgate transducer accurately and effectively. First, a magnetic circuit model is established and simulated using ANSYS Maxwell. Then a circuit simulation model is designed in Altium Designer. Finally, the magnetic circuit model is integrated with circuit simulation model in ANSYS Simplorer to establish an electromagnetic simulation model. Results show that the proposed electromagnetic simulation model can be used to calculate the linearlity error of the self-oscillating fluxgate transducer effectively.

articleTitle: Improved direct torque control based on permanent magnet synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Sliding mode control was established to address the issues with traditional direct torque control of permanent magnet synchronous motors, such as excessive magnetic flux and torque ripple, poor low-speed characteristics, etc. Enhance direct torque control by substituting the voltage vector calculation unit of conventional direct torque control with two sliding mode controllers, torque and flux, and then controlling motor operation using the spatial pulse width modulation technique. The findings of the simulation, which was conducted using Matlab/Simulink for modeling and analysis, demonstrate that the improved direct torque control strategy with sliding mode control has superior dynamic performance, resilience, and less torque pulsation than traditional direct torque control. Enhancing the direct torque control approach can meet the actual requirements of motor control while also effectively improving the PMSM motor control system’s characteristics.

articleTitle: An automated security policy generation method based on rule-matching and machine-learning models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: With the increasing diversification of security threats and the expanding scale of industrial control system networks, traditional manual policy generation methods are inadequate for the swift response required and are prone to configuration errors. An automated security policy generation method is proposed in this paper, integrating rule-matching with machine learning models to dynamically adapt to network security conditions, thereby effectively enhancing response speed and accuracy. By minimizing human intervention, the method reduces the risks associated with misconfiguration errors and employs machine learning algorithms for precise identification and response to security threats, offering more robust security protection for industrial control systems.

articleTitle: Signal Generator Based Prescribed-Time Anti-Disturbance Containment Control for Multi-agent Systems with An Application to Multiple Manipulator System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: This paper investigates the distributed containment control problem for a class of multi-agent systems containing uncertainties and external disturbances. We propose an embedded control structure consisting of two modules to address this issue. In module I, a containment control signal generator with prescribed-time convergence is constructed by combining prescribed-time control and containment control, and its output signal is capable of achieving the desired containment control objective. In Module II, the output of the signal generator serves as the reference trajectory for the actual agent. In order to estimate the nonlinear term and disturbances in the system, an extended state observer is combined, and then prescribed-time feedback anti-disturbance tracking controllers are designed for the agents to track the corresponding outputs of the signal generator. The two-layer control framework allows the multi-agent systems to attain the objective of prescribed-time containment control. In contrast to previous studies, the proposed distributed containment control algorithm can prevent the real agents from being impacted by the convoluted communication network and has remarkable anti-disturbance qualities. The designed controller’s effectiveness is confirmed through numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Distance-based formation control for wheeled mobile robots with prescribed performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: In this article, a distance-based prescribed performance formation control for multi wheeled mobile robots subject to external disturbance is proposed. A finite-time extended state observer is established to estimate the disturbances. Connectivity maintenance and collision avoidance are incorporated into the design of the performance boundary function by appropriately designing constraints on the distance error among neighboring robots. A novel distributed prescribed performance formation control scheme is proposed to ensure the transient and stead-state performance on the distance-based formation errors. Finally, simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: An improved HTNet micro-expression recognition method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Micro-expressions refer to brief and subtle changes in facial expressions, which correspond to different emotional states. Therefore, research on micro expressions is of great significance. At present, most of the micro expression recognition methods related to neural networks have good recognition performance, but the computational complexity needs to be improved. Therefore, this article proposes a lightweight Hierarchical Transformer Netwok (HTNet) model (LHTNet), which uses HTNet as the teacher model and the lightweight HTNet model as the student model to learn the feature representation of the teacher model. The feature distillation technique is used to extract the advanced features in the teacher model and transfer the feature knowledge to the student model learning to improve the performance of the student model. The deep separable convolution is introduced into the feedforward fully connected network (FNN) and the multi-head self-attention mechanism in the transformer layer to replace the standard convolution layer. Experiments on CASME2, SAMM and SMIC datasets show that the improved model has achieved significant performance improvement in micro-expression recognition tasks, and the number of model parameters and computational complexity have also been effectively reduced.

articleTitle: The application of online monitoring technology in the structural safety monitoring of the runner chamber
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: This paper aims to explore the online monitoring technology for the structural safety of the runner chamber in bulb tubular turbine units. By establishing a comprehensive online monitoring system, it achieves real-time monitoring and analysis of key parameters such as unit vibration, pressure, and stress, thereby enhancing the operational safety and reliability of the units. The article elaborately explains the technical approach, the implementation plan for online monitoring, and the layout scheme for vibration, pressure, and stress measurement points. Furthermore, this system has been successfully implemented in engineering applications, yielding favorable results.

articleTitle: Research on cycle life prediction model of electronic bonding structure based on Anand equation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: In the field of electronic information equipment, the package reliability of power semiconductor devices plays a key role in the use of products. However, the traditional optimized design faces the disadvantages of long research and development cycle, high development cost, etc., and there is an urgent need to accelerate the transformation of digital research and development model. Therefore, in this work we developed a temperature life prediction model for the connection interface of power semiconductor devices based on Anand’s equation and used it as a design objective to optimize the size of the substrate and the geometry of the microstructure. The model can realize multi-professional collaborative linkage, significantly improve design efficiency, comprehensively reduce development costs, and can realize a large number of complex simulation calculations.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Agricultural Logistics Control System Based on IoT Techology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: In today’s society, the agricultural logistics and transportation industry faces numerous challenges in meeting the demands for fresh produce preservation and efficient transport. Insufficient environmental monitoring and information management during transportation lead to increased logistics costs and high produce spoilage rates. A high-quality, efficient logistics control system is essential for the agricultural supply chain. This paper presents a logistics control system based on IoT technology, centered on the ESP32 chip, utilizing ESP-NOW and MQTT protocols for communication, integrating multi-sensor data and RFID technology. A sensor module and host gateway were designed, along with a cloud platform visualization dashboard. Through this system, users can view sensor data, track item dynamics, and effectively monitor and control the agricultural logistics process in real-time, enhancing both the efficiency and quality of agricultural logistics.

articleTitle: Study on the Stage Electric Response Characteristics of Electrically Controlled Solid Propellants
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: In response to the issue of electrical response characteristics of electrically controlled solid propellants, electrical response testing experiments were designed and carried out. The results showed that the current response of electrically controlled solid propellants under external voltage signals has obvious periodicity; When the voltage linearly increases, the current transitions around $80-90 \text{V}, 100 \text{V}$, and 120 V, respectively; An increase in the rate of voltage change will also increase the rate of current change, but the periodic characteristics will not disappear.

articleTitle: Design of Portable On-line ECG Monitor
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) monitors can not only measure ECG signals in real-time but also predict the likelihood of future cardiac conditions. However, current ECG monitors have limitations such as high costs, large size, cumbersome operation, and limited application scenarios, which restrict their use in everyday life. To address these issues, this paper studies ECG signals and noise, and designs a portable on-line ECG monitor based on the STM32 microcontroller. The ECG data acquisition sensor used is the AD8232, and a median filter is applied to process the collected ECG signals. The median filter model which is most suitable for ECG filtering is designed, and the analysis of variance is designed to evaluate the filtering effect. The monitor displays ECG waveforms on its built-in LCD screen and features a SYN6288 voice broadcasting chip for audio output. The monitor also employs a Mini SD card for data storage and is equipped with an HC-05 Bluetooth module for data transmission. The designed monitor has a compact area of only $70 \mathbf{~ c m}^{2}$, offering low cost, portability, high-precision measurement, and real-time data transmission, making it suitable for a variety of applications.

articleTitle: A Robust In-Motion Alignment Method for GNSSaided SINS Based on Multiple Backtracking
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low alignment accuracy and poor reliability in the alignment results of low-cost strapdown inertial navigation systems (SINS) during short-range alignment, this paper proposes an anti-interference alignment method based on a multiple backtracking scheme. Considering the nonnegligible bias error of the low-cost inertial measurement unit (IMU), a continuous vector is constructed using a sliding fixed interval method to avoid the accumulation of IMU errors during the backtracking process. Improved observation vectors are constructed using designed gradient values to isolate the outliers of the GNSS output. The proposed multiple backtracking alignment method continuously corrects correlation errors during the process of backtracking filtering to obtain a more accurate attitude matrix. Simulation results show that, compared to previous methods, the proposed method exhibits faster alignment speed, stronger anti-interference capability, and significantly improved alignment accuracy.

articleTitle: A Method for Detecting Abnormal Datas of Transfomer-Users Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: The abnormal data in the distribution network adversely affects the load forecasting, scheduling, and troubleshooting processes of the power system, making it crucial to accurately detect and identify such data. This paper brings in a method for detecting unusual data in the distribution network using the Transformer model. First, an input sequence is constructed to capture various features, including time dependencies. Next, the Transformer model is incorporated into a generative adversarial network (GAN) to create the generator and discriminator, enhancing the detection capabilities for abnormal data through sequence reconstruction. Finally, the test data is fed into the trained model, with the discriminator generating an abnormality score. The power of the putted forward approach is validated through a true-earth situation study of a substation in Jiangsu. This research offers valuable insights into detecting abnormal data in power systems using deep learning techniques.

articleTitle: Research on Sensorless Control Based on Adaptive Sliding Mode Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of poor performance of mechanical sensors in the traditional permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) control system in the high-salt and high-humidity environment of the ship cabin, the sensorless control strategy of the motor is studied. Based on the traditional sliding mode control strategy, an adaptive sliding mode observer algorithm is proposed. Firstly, a continuous sigmoid function is used to replace the traditional sign function. Secondly, an adaptive sliding mode observer algorithm is proposed to reduce the high-frequency components in the back electromotive force (EMF) measurement and reduce the jitter phenomenon in the control system. Thirdly, in order to make full use of the advantages of the sigmoid function, an adaptive feedback gain is added in the adaptive SMO. Finally, a phase-locked loop (PLL) control is used to extract rotor speed and position information from the EMF. In order to verify the feasibility of the algorithm, a motor simulation model is established on the Matlab/Simulink platform, and the effectiveness and accuracy of the algorithm are obtained through analysis.

articleTitle: Design and experimental research of an underwater respiratory monitoring device
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: This study introduces an innovative underwater respiratory monitoring device that uses circular microphone array technology to capture subtle acoustic signals generated by divers’ respiration underwater in real-time, thereby enhancing the safety of diving operations. The device employs a multi-microphone collaborative approach combined with sophisticated signal processing algorithms to conduct multi-stage signal processing. These algorithms include preliminary filtering to reduce environmental noise interference, signal envelope extraction to obtain clear respiratory signals, and peak detection to achieve an accurate evaluation of respiratory frequency. This paper provides a detailed description of the design and implementation of the hardware system, including the unique selection and configuration of the microphone array, as well as the development of the signal processing module. To evaluate the performance of the device, we conducted experiments in various environments, including on land, in shallow water, and in deep water. The results demonstrate that the device exhibits high sensitivity and stability in detecting various respiratory states, such as static respiration, dynamic respiration, and apnea. Through its unique hardware design and innovative signal processing methods, this study offers a novel solution for enhancing diving safety monitoring.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of flood prevention and sealing device at the entrance of GCB room of hydropower station
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Flood control blocking and water-blocking plates play a crucial role in flood control and disaster reduction. In the event of an emergency flood, the water barrier should quickly close to block the flood. This article mainly introduces a suspension bridge-type flood control and water-blocking device and analyzes the key components of the water-blocking plate device through calculation and mechanical simulation. The results showed that the waterproof baffle can effectively support a heavy object of 3 tons, and the time required for the baffle to close is only 0.6 minutes. It can respond quickly in emergency situations, effectively ensuring the smooth progress of flood prevention and sealing operations.

articleTitle: Frequency measurement method of vibrating wire sensor in complex noise environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Vibration string sensors are widely used in the safety monitoring of bridges, dams, and other structures. With the construction of pumped storage power stations such as Lianghekou, pumped storage power stations are facing challenges such as high altitude and harsh operating environments. Therefore, it is extremely important to excite the vibrating wire sensor reliably, measure the frequency reliably to estimate the stress on the vibrating wire sensor accurately and monitor the state of the building structure. However, vibrating wire sensors are often installed and buried with the main project during the construction period. Most of them have been in use for many years. Due to poor burial areas and noise interference, the accuracy of the measurements is greatly reduced. This article proposes a sweep frequency complex excitation strategy based on the maximum likelihood estimation theory, using its confidence interval as the secondary sweep frequency excitation complex interval. In harsh situations with very low signal-to-noise ratio, intermittent excitation is used to obtain the working signal submerged in noise accurately.

articleTitle: Industrial Robot Control System Integration Design and Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: This paper discusses the integrated design and application of industrial robot control system, focusing on the analysis of the system’s composition structure, communication mode and integrated control of peripheral devices. The industrial robot system is mainly composed of the robot body, control system and peripheral devices, in which the control system adopts the fieldbus technology of Ethernet for data transmission, and the widely used protocols include ProfiNet, EtherCAT and EtherNet/IP. in order to improve the integration degree of the system, the integration scheme based on the EtherCAT protocol is adopted, which realizes the peripheral devices’ efficient control and cooperative operation of peripheral devices. In addition, this paper also introduces the design and application of the downforce control system and automatic tracking control system. The downforce control system realizes precise control of the robot motion through pressure sensors and control software, while the automatic tracking control system utilizes advanced visual recognition technology, which is able to capture the motion state of the target object in real time and track it effectively. Through a series of system tests, the performance indexes of the auto-tracking control system, such as response time, data accuracy, communication stability and processing capability, are verified, and the results show that the system is able to meet the needs of modern industrial production.

articleTitle: The Utilization of Deep Learning Technology in the Detection of Laser Welding Defects
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: In order to be able to detect laser welding defects in real time, eliminate unqualified weldments, and reduce industrial production safety accidents, the deep learning technology was applied to the process of laser welding defect detection, and the MSCNN-BiLSTMM-AM model was proposed. By establishing a dataset of 9 defect states and 1 normal state, and then using the established dataset to train and test the model, through comparative studies, It was discovered that the overall performance of the proposed model was superior to that of other models, and the recognition rate of laser welding defect detection reached $99.39 \%$.

articleTitle: Computational analysis of Mechanical Vapor Compression (MVC) distillation system
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: In this paper, a Mechanical Vapor Compression (MVC) distillation system is analyzed and designed. Several variables (such as feed temperature, saturation temperature, recovery ratio, and compressor power) are analyzed in detail to find the optimization design parameters. Economic analysis and Second Law efficiencies are also calculated to measure the performance of the MVC system. The feed temperature is specified as $20^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, and the compressor pressure ratio is set at 1.35, while achieving an optimized recovery ratio of 0.86. At the same time, SCOW (Simplified Cost of water) is about $2 {\$}$ /ton, and $\boldsymbol{\eta}_{\text {II }}$ (Second Law efficiencies) is 0.28.

articleTitle: Electro-Hydraulic Position Synchronous Servo System Based on Adaptive Sliding Mode Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Aiming at the common problems in electro-hydraulic servo system, such as nonlinear friction, external interference force and parameter uncertainty, an adaptive sliding mode control strategy is designed based on the combination of adaptive control and sliding mode control. In order to ensure the precision of position synchronization, a cross-coupling strategy is introduced in adaptive sliding mode control. Finally, through tracking simulation test, compared with PID control method, it is verified that adaptive sliding mode control has better position tracking accuracy and synchronous control accuracy, and the response time is faster, and the anti-interference ability is stronger.

articleTitle: A Model for Completing The Transformer-user Linked Data Based on Variational Autoencoder and Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Complete data is important for the stable operation of the power system, however, in the collection process, due to various reasons, the phenomenon of missing data often occurs.In order to make up for the missing data, this paper proposes a Missing data Imputation by Grouped Variational Autoencoder Generative Adversarial Network(MI-GVAEGAN).The model employs the idea of variational inference on incomplete datasets to generate estimates of missing data, and uses discriminator adversarial training generative network to complete the missing data. Finally, it is compared with commonly used missing complementation algorithms under conditions of different missing rates of data.

articleTitle: Multi-Energy Storage Participates in the Peak Regulation Auxiliary Service of the Power Market
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: With the advantages of integrating multiple energy storage technologies, multi-energy storage systems can effectively cope with the fluctuation of power demand and bring flexible peak shaving capabilities to the power market. These systems can quickly respond to the critical moment of power supply and demand, balance the power grid load, and significantly improve the stability and reliability of the power system. This paper introduces a multi-energy storage system that combines supercapacitors and batteries, and proposes a capacity optimization configuration method for its participation in the peak regulation auxiliary service of the power market. This method has been verified in practical applications. By participating in peak regulation auxiliary services, the commercialization process of multi-energy storage technology is accelerated, and the competition and innovation of the power market are promoted, which provides a solid support for the construction of a more intelligent and efficient power system.

articleTitle: Research on The Two-parameter Joint Control System of Plasma Discharge Cavity Based on Adaptive PID
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Large area closed RF discharge plasma system has multi-variable, large delay, nonlinear and strong coupling between its control loops. A single-neuron adaptive PID control strategy was proposed to maintain the stability of the plasma discharge cavity. By comparing the ability of traditional PID control and single-neuron adaptive PID control in Simulink, it is concluded that single-neuron adaptive PID control has better stability and dynamic performance. The model of pressure control loop and intake control loop is built, and the target step curve is tracked in the presence of interference to reflect the stability of stable intake and pressure balance of the plasma discharge chamber.

articleTitle: A Rainy Day Object Detection Method Based on YOLOv11 Combined with FFT and MF Model Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: At the entrance of the GCB room in a power station, flood protection grooves are installed. In case of emergencies, such as Rainstorm weather, manual installation of blocking boards, flood protection sandbags, and other materials is required outside the GCB room. This manual process is time-consuming, inefficient, difficult to carry out, and involves high labor risks. It may also lead to significant water leakage and poor sealing performance, potentially allowing water ingress that threatens the safe operation of equipment. Therefore, the development of an automatic flood protection sealing device is being explored. This device should be capable of remote and on-site deployment during emergencies, allowing rapid sealing to prevent rainwater from flooding the plant through the GCB room door. During Rainstorm flooding, the flood protection sealing device will be deployed outside the GCB room. When the flood barrier is raised during a Rainstorm flooding event, there may be objects or personnel on the barrier. To prevent hazards and avoid objects sliding into the hinge area, which could block its closure, this paper proposes a method to detect the presence of workers or equipment in designated areas under low-light conditions. The method integrates YOLOv11, FFT, MF, and model fusion to ensure reliable detection during rainy conditions.

articleTitle: Evolution and Challenges of the New-Type Power System: Transformation under the Carbon Neutrality Goal
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Amid the severe backdrop of global climate change, achieving carbon peaking and neutrality has emerged as a universal consensus and the cornerstone of energy policies worldwide. As the largest energy consumer and carbon emitter, China’s profound transformation of its power system holds paramount significance for global climate governance. This paper delves into the backdrop, characteristics, current development status, multifaceted challenges, and future trends of China’s newtype power system. It aims to provide theoretical underpinnings and practical guidance for accelerating the realization of the “dual carbon” (carbon peaking and neutrality) goals. Additionally, this research explores the application of advanced control and automation technologies in the power system transformation. For example, the intelligent grid technologies, such as the Internet of Things and big data analytics, play a crucial role in enhancing the grid’s sensing and control capabilities, which are essential aspects of advanced control systems. Moreover, the research on energy storage technology and its integration into the power system involves innovative control strategies and optimization algorithms, directly contributing to the field of automation technologies in the power sector.

Author Keywords: dual carbon goals (carbon peaking and carbon neutrality)

articleTitle: A novel Artificial Vulture Optimization Algorithm and its application on the aluminum smelting furnace temperature prediction system
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: In the aluminum smelting process, real-time monitoring of furnace temperature using thermal sensors is costly and inconvenient due to high furnace temperature. To solve this problem, a hybrid model for predicting furnace temperature in an aluminum smelting furnace based on the Matérn kernel function is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the furnace temperature mechanism model is established based on the law of energy conservation and the mechanism characteristics of the aluminum smelting process. Since unknown variables are used in the process of establishing the mechanistic model, a hybrid model for furnace temperature prediction is obtained by fitting the unknown variables using the Matérn kernel function. In addition, the furnace temperature prediction system based on the hybrid prediction model is developed to enhance the generalization capability of the hybrid prediction model. The parameter identification issue within the furnace temperature prediction system can be framed as an optimization problem. For this optimization problem, an improved artificial vulture algorithm (OMAVOA) is proposed. Experimental results indicate that OMAVOA outperforms other optimization algorithms, and the furnace temperature prediction system accurately predicts furnace temperature.

articleTitle: UAV Obstacle Avoidance Path Planning Based on Improved Artificial Potential Field Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of target unreachability, local minima trap and long path length in artificial potential field method, an improved UAV obstacle avoidance path planning algorithm based on traditional artificial potential field method is proposed. The relative distance is introduced into the repulsive potential field function to solve the target unreachability problem; the regulatory force is introduced into the traditional artificial potential field method to solve the local minima trap problem; and the detection factor is introduced into the traditional artificial potential field method to exclude the influence of ineffective repulsive force, so as to optimize the obstacle avoidance path of UAVs and reduce the length of the path. The final simulation results show that the improved algorithm effectively solves the problems of target inaccessibility, local minima traps, and long path length, and reduces the path length by $9 \%-15 \%$. The algorithm effectively improves the obstacle avoidance efficiency compared with the traditional artificial potential field method.

articleTitle: A New MRACS Approach for High-order System Following Low-order Model Using State Variables Taking from the Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: This paper proposes a model reference adaptive control system (MRACS) approach for high-order systems that are required to follow a low-order model, utilizing state variables derived from the model itself. Drawing from Popov hyperstability theory, the method addresses several critical challenges in control system design. The MRAC strategy is employed to tackle the issue of unmeasurable plant states, enabling the control system to adaptively adjust despite the lack of direct state measurement. This adaptation is crucial in maintaining system stability and performance in the presence of uncertainties. To enhance the robustness of the control system, an adjustable linear compensator is introduced. This compensator alleviates the need for the assumption of strictly positive real conditions, which is often a limitation in traditional control methods. By incorporating this flexible compensation mechanism, the proposed approach ensures better handling of various system dynamics and uncertainties, thereby increasing the overall reliability of the control system. The effectiveness of the proposed MRACS approach is substantiated through comprehensive digital simulation results. These results demonstrate that the controlled object is capable of closely following the output of the reference model, highlighting the robustness and adaptability of the method. This capability is particularly advantageous in practical engineering applications, where precision and reliability are paramount.

Author Keywords: Taking states variables from the model

articleTitle: Research of Multi-channel Digital Filters Based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: This paper introduces how to use MATLAB to generate FIR filter coefficient, and the design of n-order digital filter can be realized quickly by using FIR filter library function of DSP. Aiming at the signal processing process of signal and noise signal acquisition system, a digital low-pass FIR filter based on DSP is designed and implemented, and the FIR filter of DSP is verified by simulation experiment and system test, and the filtering process of sinusoidal signal with noise is realized.

articleTitle: Design for Safe Handling Disposal of the Lithium Waste Power Batteries in a Disassembly Line using Control System Equipped with Machine learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: With the rapid development of electric vehicles, the problem of disposing of waste power batteries has become increasingly prominent. The optimization of the dismantling process route for waste power batteries is a key step before dismantling, which directly determines the economic benefits of dismantling. Taking a certain model of waste power battery as an example, based on the analysis of the uncertainty of the dismantling efficiency of waste power batteries, a machine learning method is proposed to solve the problem of the coupling of characteristic factors affecting it, and a machine learning based optimization framework for the dismantling process of waste power batteries is constructed. This article attempts various machine learning models, such as multi-layer perceptron models, and ultimately proposes a transformer based disassembly order prediction method. Based on the results of simulation training, a brand new lithium battery disassembly production line is designed. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified through experimental verification and comparative analysis of the calculation results

articleTitle: Forging Production Line Simulation Based on RobotStudio
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: With societal progress and scientific development, intelligence has increasingly entered the public’s field of vision. Replacing previous manual operations, artificial intelligence technology is widely applied in almost every stage of the manufacturing process. To respond to the trend of the times and improve production efficiency, many old die forging factories in China are gradually transforming towards intelligent production. Employing intelligent robots for production line control, processing, and workpiece position monitoring can significantly improve production efficiency and reduce labor costs. Hot die forging typically involves multiple processes: blanking, heating, pre-forming, pre-forging, final forging, trimming, and straightening. Depending on the requirements for the shape, size, and precision of the forged parts, some processes may be omitted. Production line layout design is closely related to the correct selection and utilization of equipment, ensuring product precision and quality, improving production efficiency, reducing production line investment and daily production costs, and improving the production environment. This paper uses software simulation to simulate the actual operation of the production line, calculates production efficiency, and then performs feasibility analysis of the production line. This paper utilizes SolidWorks software to establish models of various components of the production line; designs the production line layout based on the required forging functions; and utilizes RobotStudio software to simulate the operation of this forging production line, simulating the production line’s operation, calculating its cycle time, obtaining the production efficiency of the production line, and analyzing its feasibility.

articleTitle: Wind Power Prediction with Ramp Events Detection Based on Multi-layers Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Aiming at the instability of wind power time series, in order to improve the accuracy of the identification of Wind Power Ramp Events (WPREs) in the original wind power series, this paper proposes a WPRE detection method that combines two-stage decomposition method with WPREs definition. In the wind power prediction part, this paper uses a multi-layers architecture to improve the accuracy of wind power forecasting results. Firstly, the Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition (EEMD) of the original data is integrated in the data processing layer, and the complexity of each component is calculated by using the Sample Entropy (SE), and it is divided into random component, detail component and trend component. Then the Variational Modal Decomposition (VMD) is used to decompose the random components with more noise. In the prediction layer, considering that Stochastic Configuration Networks (SCNs) model has better processing effect on smooth component, while Echo State Networks (ESN) model has better processing effect on non-linear time series, SCNs model is used to predict detail component and trend component, and ESN model is used to predict random component. Then the prediction results of wind power are superimposed. In the part of WPREs recognition, this paper replaces the original data with the predicted results and uses the method of WPREs definition combination to identify ramp events and non-ramp events in the original wind power sequence.

articleTitle: Research on the influence of temperature control uniformity in thermal vacuum test of high-power supply products
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: During the thermal vacuum test of aerospace products, the temperature control methods are different, resulting in a large deviation in the results of the thermal vacuum test, which is more evident in high-power supply products. The influence of varying temperature control methods on the test results in the thermal vacuum test of high-power supply products is studied. The effects of heating methods of vacuum tanks, temperature rise, and fall rates, the size of heating up the steps, and the inflection point of heating rates on the uniformity of temperature control are analyzed and verified by experiment. The test results show that the temperature uniformity of the oil bath-type thermal vacuum tank is better than that of the thermal radiation-type thermal vacuum tank for high-power supply products. The maximum temperature difference between the surface of the test piece and the temperature control point decreases as the actual heating rate decreases. In addition, it is found that the maximum temperature difference between the surface of the test piece and the temperature control point can be reduced by adding steps or reducing the heating rate when the heating process is close to the target temperature compared with a uniform temperature rising rate.

articleTitle: UAV Flight Phase Recognition and Decision Control Based on Attitude Angle Information
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: To address the current issues of insufficient reliability analysis of environmental information and the lack of flight phase identification and decision-making control in unmanned aerial vehicles(UAVs), this study investigates the use of onboard systems to distinguish different flight phases based on attitude angle information. By analyzing the available environmental information of a selected UAV, a method for environmental information perception based on multi-sensor fusion is designed. A specific execution strategy is developed, which involves closing the onboard electronic switch when the variation of the attitude angle (pitch angle) within a time window is smaller than a set threshold. This is implemented in cooperation with the judgment circuit and execution circuit. The feasibility of the strategy is validated through UAV flight experiments and circuit functionality tests. Experimental results indicate that the UAV onboard system can identify different flight phases based on pitch angle data and drive actuator actions to close the electronic switch as required.

articleTitle: D265-12 Diesel Engine Piston and Cylinder Liner Percussion Noise Calculation and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: In this paper, the multi-rigid body dynamics analysis of the piston mechanism of D265-12 diesel engine is carried out, and the obtained data are combined with the acoustic-solid interaction theory, and it is obtained that the maximum value of sound pressure level when the frequency reaches 5000 Hz is $133 \mathrm{db}(\mathrm{A})$ under the normal working condition of diesel engine, which is beyond the acceptable range of human ears, and the piston mechanism should be optimized to provide a theoretical basis for noise reduction of diesel engine.

articleTitle: Design of Autonomous and Precise Landing Tracking Algorithm for Multi Rotor Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of autonomous precision landing of UAVs and enhance the adaptability of autonomous landing of UAVs, a new type of UAV tracking algorithm is designed. First, the computational process and principle of determining the relative position between UAV and landing target are analyzed, and the shortcomings of the traditional landing target tracking algorithm are summarized. Then, the tracking learning detection (TLD) algorithm is innovatively combined with the kernelized correlation filtering (KCF) algorithm in target tracking, and the advantages of the KCF algorithm are used to optimize the TLD algorithm to obtain the TLD+KCF target tracking algorithm. Finally, the optimization algorithm based on UAV landing is proposed, and a control group is set to verify the performance of the algorithm. The comparison results show that the accuracy and success rate of the proposed algorithm exceed the comparison algorithm. The algorithm is highly accurate and stable, and can realize autonomous and accurate landing of UAV.

articleTitle: Design of a Trajectory Tracking Controller for Underactuated Unmanned Surface Vessels Based on the Backstepping Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: A trajectory tracking control method of underactuated unmanned surface vessels (USV) based on backstepping control method is proposed. Aiming at the underactuated characteristics of USV, an effective trajectory tracking controller is designed by using its kinematics model, introducing virtual control quantity and combining Lyapunov function. The asymptotic stability of the controller is proved by Lyapunov direct method, which ensures the stability of the system. The simulation results show that the trajectory tracking performance of the controller in the simulation environment is better than that of the traditional PID controller, especially in the curve path, it has better dynamic response ability and tracking accuracy. However, the test in the actual environment still needs to further verify the reliability and stability of the controller.

articleTitle: Safety Analysis and Control Strategy of Shunting Operation in Metro Depot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: The safety analysis of the shunting operation of the subway depot was carried out from the factors such as unsafe behavior of people, unsafe state of equipment, management defects and environmental interference. At the same time, in view of the hidden dangers that cause more safety production accidents, the control strategies such as digital shunting process and the establishment of a dual prevention system are proposed. Finally, through the simulation of the shunting operation process, the expected results of reducing the accident rate and improving the operation efficiency of the shunting operation are obtained.

articleTitle: Principle and Parameter Setting Method of PSS2B Model of IEEE
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the power system, the influencing factors of low-frequency oscillation and sub synchronous oscillation in the system are becoming increasingly complex. Power system stabilizer (PSS) is the most economical and effective means to suppress oscillations, among which the PSS2B type power system stabilizer has been widely used due to its unique performance advantages. However, the PSS2B model is a dual input model, which is complex and difficult for parameter setting. Aiming at this problem, the paper presents a parameter setting method based on experiments. The experiment results validated the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-based Interference Signal Recognition for Satellite Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: With the rapid development of satellite communication technology, the emergence of interference signals is becoming more and more frequent, which seriously affects the reliability and safety of communication. For this reason, this paper designs a satellite communication interference signal recognition system based on artificial intelligence, which adopts a modularized design and covers multiple aspects such as signal acquisition, pre processing, feature extraction and classification recognition. The system realizes high-fidelity signal acquisition through a high dynamic range broadband receiver, uses FPGA to carry out real-time data preprocessing, and combines deep learning technology to adaptively extract interference signal features. The classification and recognition module incorporates a variety of advanced algorithms to significantly improve the accuracy of detection and recognition. Experimental results show that the system designed in this paper exhibits excellent detection performance under different signal-to-noise ratio conditions, and the recognition accuracy reaches $\mathbf{9 7. 5 \%}$ on average, which is 5.7 percentage points higher than the traditional SVM-based algorithm. This research provides an effective guarantee for the anti-jamming capability of satellite communication system, which has important application value and promotion potential.

articleTitle: Application of Neural Network Model Considering Chaotic Vibration of Traction Gears in Locomotive Adhesion Optimization Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: The effect of the chaotic vibration of train wheels on the adhesion state is investigated, and an optimisation mechanism for locomotive adhesion control is established to improve the safety and stability of locomotive operation. A learning model for locomotive coupling state identification using deep neural networks is studied. The model studies and extracts the characteristics related to the bonding state from a large amount of data, so as to achieve the automatic classification and evaluation of different bonding states. Meanwhile, the effect of the chaotic vibration of bicycles on locomotive couplings is investigated, and the deep neural network model is further optimised. By adjusting the model structure and parameters, the stability and accuracy of the model under complex conditions can be improved. The final experimental results show that the model is $\mathbf{9 7. 4 5 \%}$ accurate and $\mathbf{9 3. 5 6 \%}$ accurate, which is much higher than other traditional methods. The results show that the method effectively reduces the chaotic vibration of the traction gearbox and significantly improves the control performance of the locomotive clutch.

articleTitle: Dynamic Inertia Weight and Learning Factor Enhanced Particle Swarm Optimization for Optimal and Coordinated Economic Dispatch of Interconnected Multi-Microgrid Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: This study concentrates on the development of an economic optimization dispatch framework for interconnected multi-microgrid systems. By dissecting the operational dynamics of distributed renewable energy resources, manageable distributed energy sources, and storage components, a comprehensive economic optimization model for an individual microgrid is formulated. In light of diverse operational limitations, this study introduces a strategy for the coordinated economic optimization dispatch of multiple microgrids, aimed at reducing both operational expenses and environmental management costs. An enhanced particle swarm optimization algorithm, which features linearly variable inertia weight and learning factor throughout iterations, is employed to resolve the model, thereby augmenting convergence rate and computational precision. The validity of the proposed model and the efficiency of the algorithm are validated via an empirical examination involving a tri-microgrid system.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Guide Car
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: In order to provide more convenience and safety for visually impaired individuals, a smart guiding cart [1] has been designed. It uses the STM32F407ZGT6 microcontroller as the main control unit and employs an incremental PID algorithm to control [2] the movement and direction of the motors. UWB (Ultra-Wideband) technology is utilized to obtain the relative distance between the base station and the tags, enabling distance positioning between the person and the cart. Speech recognition technology facilitates interaction between the person and the cart, while ultrasonic distance measurement technology detects the position of obstacles and integrates it with the motor’s movement logic to achieve obstacle avoidance. The combination of 4G network technology and GPS/Beidou navigation technology [3] allows for the transmission of location latitude and longitude information to the Gaode platform. The returned path information is then analyzed to realize the navigation function. Then, through software programming and hardware setup, the intelligent guiding vehicle will achieve functions such as person-following, language interaction [4], obstacle avoidance, and navigation. Finally, by recording relevant data and information from the testing projects, the vehicle will reach the expected functionality. The designed intelligent guiding vehicle will address some of the shortcomings of traditional guiding tools and pave the way for a new direction in the embedded industry.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Measurement Method of Intelligent Level of Measurement and Control Equipment Based on Kinetic Entropy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: For the optimization and upgrading of intelligent measurement and control equipment, it is particularly important to conduct a comprehensive assessment of its intelligence level. A comprehensive assessment method based on kinetic entropy is proposed for the intelligent level of measurement and control equipment, and a corresponding assessment model framework is constructed. First, the key factors affecting the intelligence level of measurement and control equipment are analyzed, and the measurement index system of the intelligence level of measurement and control equipment is established. Subsequently, a dynamics model is constructed to deeply describe the operation process of the measurement and control equipment by combining the physical entity characteristics, data information and environmental parameters of the equipment. On this basis, targeted test cases are designed to calculate the specific values of the evaluation indicators, and the weights of the indicators are determined with the help of information entropy theory. Through the comprehensive analysis of the weights of the indicators, this paper realizes the quantitative assessment of the intelligence level of the measurement and control equipment, and provides a solid theoretical basis for the subsequent optimization and upgrading of the equipment.

Author Keywords: intelligence level of measurement and control equipment

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Method of Transmission Line Tower Grounding Device Based on K-Means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Grounding resistance is an important indicator for measuring the lightning protection performance of transmission line towers, and is one of the important indicators for measuring the effectiveness of grounding devices. According to regulatory requirements, the requirements for grounding resistance vary in regions with different soil resistivity. However, the value of grounding resistance can clearly reflect the characteristics of the tower and the situation in the region. This article is based on the monitoring data of grounding resistance, using the k-means algorithm, and attempting to select k as 1,2, and 3 values respectively to check the classification situation. Combined with the actual site, the health status of the grounding resistance of the tower is classified, and the existing risks are identified and the tower is marked, providing reference and basis for subsequent work.

articleTitle: Forming temperature field Prediction of extrusion products based on spatiotemporal separation modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Ensuring uniform temperature distribution at the outlet of aluminum profiles is vital for producing high-performance profiles. This study proposes a spatio-temporal separation model to predict temperature data for isothermal extrusion. Simulation provides limited sampling data from the die hole outlet, which undergoes Karhunen-Loève decomposition to extract spatial basis functions. An LSTM neural network predicts time coefficients, which, combined with spatial functions, reconstruct the complete temperature field. Validated on 6063 aluminum alloy, the model achieves a prediction error of approximately $1 \%$, confirming its accuracy.

articleTitle: The Mechanic and Application of Flexible Auxiliary Support under Assembly Pre-Tightening Process
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: In order to control the pre-tightening force accurately, the assembly pre-tightening process of a flexible auxiliary support structure was studied. At first, the deformation compatibility relationship in the assembly process was obtained. A mechanical model was established by analyzing and deducing the stress and deformation of compression ring in the assembly process, and the equivalent relationship based on respective stiffness characteristic curves was given, which can be applied to establish the rapid correction of pre-tightening force (RCPF) algorithm. The problem of uncertain assembly times caused by changing gasket thickness based on engineering experience was solved. The mode of assembly and revision was realized with the RCPF program. The “one assembly, one test” approach was employed to experimentally demonstrate the effectiveness of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on integrated technology of synthetic biology automated platform
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Synthetic biology uses engineering principles to redesign organisms and construct biological systems with specific functions, which is an important way to develop drugs, vaccines, biofuels, etc. In the process of transforming synthetic organisms, researchers need to conduct largescale experiments for a long time, and many of these processes are manual and repetitive tasks, which results in the problems such as low throughput, low efficiency, and slow iteration. In addition, there are many experimental instruments and equipment required in the synthetic biology experiment process. The communication protocols between different instruments and equipment are not uniform, which seriously restricts the automation upgrade process of synthetic biology. To solve these problems, this paper put forward an integration technology based on the Object Linking and Embedding for Process Control Unified Architecture (OPC UA) to realize the interconnection of the synthetic biology automated platform and related instruments needed in synthetic biology process. The stability of the system is further designed and improved by using the concept of Triple Modular Redundancy. This helps the development of an efficient, stable and scalable automated platform for synthetic biology, which greatly improves the efficiency of synthetic biology experiments.

articleTitle: Text Classification Method Based on Approximate Nearest Neighbor Enhanced Contrastive Learning and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Text classification, as a fundamental task in the field of Natural Language Processing, plays a crucial role in various applications such as information retrieval, machine translation, and sentiment analysis. However, most deep learning models ignore the rich information of training instances during prediction, leading to insufficiently comprehensive text features. To fully leverage the information from training instances, we propose a text classification method based on approximate nearest neighbor enhanced contrastive learning and attention mechanism. Firstly, we design a nearest neighbor enhanced supervised contrastive learning training strategy, aimed at optimizing the model’s retrieval of text vector representations, thereby improving the quality of training instances retrieved during the inference process. Secondly, we construct an attention mechanism to learn the attention distribution over the acquired training text features, focusing on the information from more relevant neighbor instances to capture additional implicit similar features. Finally, we integrate the attention mechanism with the model network, merging information from neighbor training instances to enhance the model’s ability to extract diverse features, thereby achieving the extraction of both global and local features.

articleTitle: Adaptive Motion Control and Structural Design of a Spherical Robot Based on Feature Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Spherical robots (SRs), due to their enclosed shells and versatile motion capabilities, are attracting significant attention in fields such as pipeline inspection, planetary exploration, and military reconnaissance. However, SRs are underactuated, non-holonomic, and strongly coupled complex underactuated, non-holonomic, and strongly coupled complex systems, making modeling and control challenging. This paper introduces a dual-drive differential momentum wheel structure for SRs and proposes an adaptive control algorithm based on for SRs and proposes an adaptive control algorithm based on feature modeling. Considering the significant variations in the dynamic characteristics of SRs, adaptive amplitude limiting is achieved by regulating factors applied to the time-varying dynamic characteristics of SRs, adaptive amplitude limiting is achieved by regulating factors applied to the time-varying parameters of feature modeling. A golden-section adaptive control rate is employed to reduce computational complexity. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed adaptive control method significantly outperforms the classical PID controller in terms of control performance and dynamic response, proving its effectiveness in enhancing the robustness of SRs against disturbances and dynamic environments.

articleTitle: Extrinsic Calibration Method for LiDAR and Millimeter-Wave Radar Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Millimeter-wave radar, with its high frequency and short wavelength, is increasingly becoming a critical sensor in autonomous driving systems, where precise external calibration with lidar is essential for efficient sensor fusion. However, existing calibration algorithms for these two sensors are still limited. To address this, we propose an offline external calibration method based on a novel 3D calibration target that combines absorbing materials and corner reflectors. Using a point cloud segmentation network, we extract lidar target point clouds and utilize RCS information with clustering to accurately locate radar point clouds, achieving precise data extraction for different sensors. Additionally, we introduce a model coordinate system as a bridge to resolve the spatial relationship between lidar and radar, and enhance the ICP alignment algorithm by calculating an initial alignment matrix with minimal error straight-line alignment, allowing for coarse-to-fine optimization. This approach significantly improves ICP precision and efficiency, with experimental results in various scenarios validating the calibration accuracy and reliability of this method.

articleTitle: Load forecasting of port multi-energy fusion power system based on improved FFT and ConvMLP-GRU
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: Accurate electrical load prediction is essential for the stable operation of multi-energy fusion power systems at ports, which integrate wind and solar energy. To address the challenges of low prediction accuracy for long sequences, stemming from disordered port load data and insufficient semantic information, this paper proposes a load power forecasting method based on an improved FFT and ConvMLP-GRU. The Hanning window function is employed to optimize the FFT process, thereby reducing spectral leakage and endpoint effects. The top k amplitudes and their corresponding frequencies are extracted to compute the data period, allowing for the decomposition of the original load data into a two-dimensional tensor. ConvMLP is then utilized to extract features both within and between data periods, while GRU are employed for load prediction. Experimental results using load data from the port of Ningbo demonstrate that the proposed method enhances short-term prediction accuracy and reduces prediction errors for long sequences when compared to classical deep learning models.

articleTitle: Model-Driven Behavioral Modeling and Verification Methods for Human-Machine Hybrid Intelligent Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: The design phase endows the product with innate quality, especially the quality of front-end design, which directly determines the final interactive characteristics and user experience of the product. In order to reduce human-machine behavior conflicts, it is necessary to model and validate human-machine hybrid intelligent systems at the behavioral level in the early stages of design. In response to the difficulties in characterizing multimodal interactions and supporting simulation based behavior optimization design caused by “human in the loop”, firstly, the SysML state machine diagram was extended based on the characteristics of human-computer interaction behavior, and a meta behavior and formal representation model for human-machine hybrid intelligent systems was established. Subsequently, a semantic mapping rule from the human-computer interaction behavior model to the PRISM probabilistic time automaton was proposed, and the requirement specification of the human-machine hybrid intelligent system was validated using probabilistic time computation tree logic. A model driven behavior modeling and validation method for human-machine hybrid intelligent systems was proposed. Finally, the feasibility of the method was verified by taking the design of a human-machine hybrid intelligent system for handling human-machine collaborative assembly anomalies as an example.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Control of Electro-Hydraulic Servo Systems under Variable Load Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: To address the control challenges of electro-hydraulic servo systems under variable load conditions, such as nonlinearities and uncertainties due to uneven load distribution during launch, a nonlinear control strategy based on a multi-domain coupling model is proposed. A high-performance Robust Integral of the Sign of the Error (RISE) controller is designed by analyzing the dynamic model of the drive system. Using a variable radius rotational system as a test prototype, the effectiveness of different control strategies is verified through co-simulation using the Adams/Matlab joint simulation method. The results show that the proposed RISE controller improves error control performance by over 60% compared to traditional PID and Feedback Linearization Controller (FLC), providing effective technical support for precise control of electro-hydraulic servo systems under variable load conditions.

articleTitle: Dual-UAVs Collaborative Target Localization and Configuration Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: A dual-UAVs collaborative bearings-only target localization method is proposed to address the common problem of low localization accuracy in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) target localization. This method establishes a dual-UAVs collaborative localization model based on a three-dimensional coordinate system, utilizing the yaw and pitch angles information observed by the dual-UAVs on the target, as well as the Total least squares algorithm for collaborative localization. Simulation experiments have verified that the dual-UAVs collaborative bearings-only target localization method significantly improves the accuracy of target localization. To improve the localization accuracy of the dual-UAVs, Spherical error probable analysis is also performed in the three-dimensional coordinate system to analyze the impact of different factors on localization accuracy. Meanwhile, through the analysis of the simulation results, a configuration optimization for dual-UAVs collaborative localization was proposed to further optimize localization accuracy. The conclusion provides a feasible solution for dual-UAVs collaborative bearings-only target localization and provides a certain reference for future research. sheet, as illustrated by the portions given in this document.

articleTitle: Research on the Control Characteristics of Three Types of Coil type Electromagnetic Launcher
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: To investigate whether the sleeve armature, induction coil armature, and direct fed coil armature of three electromagnetic emitters have the same control law, the McKinney analysis method was used to establish the control equations of the three systems, and the control equations were organized into the same structure. The finite element analysis method was used to establish the finite element models of the three systems, and the motion process of the three systems was calculated through the control equations and finite element models. The results showed that the calculated values of the two models were basically the same, verifying the accuracy of the models and proving that although the configurations of the three systems were different, they had the same control law.

articleTitle: A Signal Denoising Method for Pulsed Eddy Current Testing Based on Parameter Optimization of VMD Combined with Wavelet Threshold
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: A noise identification and separation technique for pulse eddy current detection signals built on the combination of arithmetic optimization algorithm (AOA) and variational modulus decomposition (VMD) is proposed to address the problem of difficulty in accurately extracting feature quantities from pulse eddy current detection signals under working condition noise. This process anticipates the characteristics of non-stationary signals in pulse eddy current detection signals. Firstly, the VMD algorithm is optimized using arithmetic optimization algorithms, and the fitness function utilizes sample entropy to acquire a sequence of intrinsic mode function components (IMF) with band-limited characteristics. The correlation coefficient between each modal component and the original signal is employed to classify the signal into effective and noise components. Finally, filtering of the effective components is done to further improve signal performance. The experimental results show that AOA-VMD can effectively eliminate strong noise and achieve better performance.

articleTitle: Control of a single-leg robot Based on Closed-Loop PD-Type Iterative Learning and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: To mitigate distributed load disturbances affecting wading-legged robots in underwater environments, along with nonlinear disruptions stemming from frictional forces and model inaccuracies, this paper introduces an integrated control approach. In this paper, to ensure the stability and trajectory accuracy of the underwater robot’s motion in shallow water, a closed-loop PD control-based iterative learning approach combined with a radial basis function (RBF) neural network is adopted. The proposed method first divides external disturbances into periodic and non-periodic components, handled separately. The RBF neural network is employed for real-time modeling and to compensate for non-periodic disturbances, leveraging its superior approximation capabilities to estimate unknown nonlinear elements effectively. To counteract periodic disturbances, the closed-loop PD-type iterative learning controller progressively refines the control law, thereby correcting recurrent trajectory tracking deviations.A neural network is utilized to continuously approximate the modeling error, while iterative learning control repeatedly adjusts the trajectory based on error correction. The proposed framework effectively adapts to the motion environment of the robot in this study.Experimental results substantiate that the devised control strategy robustly mitigates uncertainties induced by unknown distributed load disturbances, markedly advancing control accuracy and system robustness.

articleTitle: Research on bearing surface defect detection based on CBAM and BN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advanced Control Systems and Automation Technologies (ACSAT)
abstract: For the detection and classification of bearing surface defects, we built a small-scale convolutional neural network. In order to enhance the network to extract defect features, convolutional attention module is added to the network structure by convolutional attention mechanism. In order to change the linear relationship of the network model, activation functions are added to the structure, and the performance of sigmoid, tanh and ReLU activation functions in the model training process is compared. In order to enhance the training speed of convolutional neural networks and avoid the problem of gradient disappearing or gradient explosion which may occur in the training process, batch normalization layer is added. The complete structure of convolutional neural network is determined, and the performance of SGD, RMSProp and Adam optimizers in model training is compared. Finally, experiments are carried out on the data set of bearing surface holes. The classification accuracy of verification set is as high as $\mathbf{9 9. 3 \%}$, and the classification accuracy of test set is as high as $\mathbf{9 8. 7 \%}$. The average detection time of a single image is about 9.7 ms.
